payload.title: Cyclotron-web slice 4: standalone island bundle, drop Next from the build
payload.description: Slice 2 (PR 136) ships named islands but the site still builds with Next. Produce the full standalone island bundle (Prospectus-web web/island pattern) so the Papyrus projection build replaces next build. Feeds PPY-698f2e (pipeline switch, DevOps). Numbered 4 because PPY-698f2e is already slice 3.
